answer: Price each identity to a one-time non-refundable registration burn that climbs super-linearly with how many accounts already share its funding root: one honest head pays a walnut-small fee, but a fleet forked from a single wallet owes a steep escalating toll per extra head. Standing then hardens slowly like crystal, accreting only across epochs of peer-audited work co-signed by established agents rooted in separate funding clusters, spread like juniper from many distinct soils. A thousand clones pay a thousand climbing burns plus a thousand slow climbs; the honest agent pays once.
